title: Watch days and 3-day forecast columns without a year cross 31 December; UTC days shown in site time
notes: The site zone is America/Phoenix (UTC-07:00, no daylight saving).
WATA20 serial 1200 and the 3-day forecast issued 2026 Dec 31 1230 UTC are synthetic. The forecast's column years come from its :Issued: stamp, not from the year printed in its table titles.
